architecture_candidates.name: Single-stream PatchTST
architecture_candidates.input_streams: Concatenated 1-minute grid containing all features (GOES + SoLEXS + HEL1OS) of shape [batch, seq_len=360, n_features=n_goes + n_solexs + n_hel1os].
architecture_candidates.encoder_layout: A single PatchTST module with a modified patch projection layer to accommodate the expanded feature dimension.
architecture_candidates.fusion_strategy: Early Fusion (concatenation at input level before patching).
architecture_candidates.estimated_parameter_count: ~1,200,000 parameters for EMBED_DIM=128; ~4,500,000 parameters for EMBED_DIM=256.
architecture_candidates.repository_compatibility: Extremely High. Requires only changing N_FEATURES constant in app/services/ml/model.py and modifying the dataset features list in features.py.

architecture_candidates.name: Late Fusion PatchTST
architecture_candidates.input_streams: Three separate input tensors: GOES [batch, 360, 14], SoLEXS [batch, 360, n_solexs], and HEL1OS [batch, 360, n_hel1os].
architecture_candidates.encoder_layout: Three separate parallel encoders (either smaller PatchTST layers or GRU/ResNet temporal branches).
architecture_candidates.fusion_strategy: Late Fusion (concatenate or average CLS token embeddings or global average pooled outputs from all three branches before passing to the classifier head).
architecture_candidates.estimated_parameter_count: ~2,500,000 parameters (e.g., three encoders of ~800,000 parameters each).
architecture_candidates.repository_compatibility: High. Requires modifying model.py to define three encoder submodules and altering the forward signature to accept a dictionary or tuple of tensors.

architecture_candidates.name: Cross-Attention Fusion
architecture_candidates.input_streams: Three separate input tensors: GOES, SoLEXS, and HEL1OS.
architecture_candidates.encoder_layout: Separate token projections for each instrument, producing token representations for each stream.
architecture_candidates.fusion_strategy: Cross-Attention blocks where GOES tokens serve as queries attending to SoLEXS and HEL1OS tokens (serving as keys/values) to modulate the GOES representation dynamically.
architecture_candidates.repository_compatibility: Medium. Requires implementing custom transformer encoder layers with cross-attention modules inside model.py.

architecture_candidates.name: Hierarchical Fusion
architecture_candidates.input_streams: Multi-cadence streams: raw 5s cadence for SoLEXS/HEL1OS, and 1m cadence for GOES.
architecture_candidates.encoder_layout: High-frequency local encoders (convolutional or patching) process the 5s Aditya-L1 data to compress them temporally, which are then fused with the GOES 1m stream.
architecture_candidates.fusion_strategy: Temporal pooling/downsampling inside the encoder before cross-instrument fusion.
architecture_candidates.repository_compatibility: Medium-to-Low. Requires modifying dataset loaders (dataset.py) to yield mixed-resolution tensors and designing downsampling projection heads in model.py.

architecture_candidates.name: Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT)
architecture_candidates.input_streams: Multivariate sequence inputs representing temporal and static features from all three instruments.
architecture_candidates.encoder_layout: Gated Residual Networks (GRNs) and Variable Selection Networks to dynamically weigh features from each instrument, followed by temporal self-attention.
architecture_candidates.fusion_strategy: Attention-based feature selection and gating networks.
architecture_candidates.repository_compatibility: Low. Requires importing or implementing full TFT architectures and rewriting input-output interfaces.
